Millions of thanks to Mother and to Holy Son for making me and my family a witness to this Apparition.
My name is Ajina, and my husband is Prakash. I come from Varkala in the Thiruvananthapuram district. We first entered into the Covenant in 2023.
It was my husband who took it first. What I want to share first is a testimony of miraculous healing. I hadn't even placed it as a specific covenant intention.
In 2023, my husband came here, took the Covenant, and while we were faithfully observing it, one day, a relative of my sister-in-law, this brother here named Shaji,
who was admitted to the Regional Cancer Centre (RCC), needed blood. They called us to collect the blood for him. Then I told them that we are in the Covenant,
and so many powerful miracles are happening there. Because we are observing the Covenant we have the Covenant articles—the blessed salt and the anointing oil.
We told them we would bring it to them and asked them to apply it on that brother and pray before his surgery.
The brother was actually at Punalur Hospital; they live in Anchal. When he went to Punalur Hospital, there was a small swelling on his tongue.
When they sent a sample of that swelling for a biopsy, they diagnosed it as tongue cancer and referred him to RCC in Thiruvananthapuram.
There, the doctors said they had to surgically remove his jawbone and his tongue. It was for this major surgery that they needed blood and called us.
On the morning of his surgery, we brought the Covenant salt from our home and gave it to his wife,
saying, "Sister, you must pray fervently. We have also prayed earnestly. Apply this salt on his tongue and pray before the surgery."
Before he was taken into the operation theatre, she applied the blessed salt on his tongue and prayed. After the doctors took him into the surgery room,
they unexpectedly said, "For now, we will just remove the swelling and send it for a biopsy. Only after that will we remove the jawbone and the tongue."
Initially, they had firmly stated that both the jawbone and the tongue must be removed. But after entering the theatre, the doctors said,
"Let us send it for a biopsy once more. We can remove the jawbone and tongue after that." Consequently, only the flesh from the top was surgically removed.
It was sent for biopsy, and when the results came back 15 days later, there was no cancer! They did not remove his jawbone, nor his tongue.
The brother is now completely healed and perfectly healthy. That is our first testimony.
I hadn't even kept it as an intention; we just gave the blessed articles while being in the Covenant.
Later, when our Covenant period was completed, we came to renew it. Just before renewing it, my husband experienced severe stomach discomfort.
We consulted at several hospitals. Finally, when we showed it to a gastroenterologist at the Medical College, the doctor advised a colonoscopy.
Right before going for the colonoscopy we applied the Covenant salt and the anointing oil, prayed with faith, and he went in for the procedure.
They took samples in four bottles for a biopsy. Just before giving those samples for biopsy, I sprinkled the Covenant salt and prayed.
I had a strong conviction in my spirit that nothing would happen to my husband.
We are in the Covenant, so no evil will befall us. I firmly believed the result would be negative, and my faith saved us.
When the results came, it was indeed negative! After that, the doctor said the stomach ache might be due to a fatty liver.
They advised an ultrasound scan for fatty liver. When the scan was done, they found a small cyst in his liver.
So, they suggested a FibroScan. We placed it as an intention here, prayed, applied the anointing oil, made the sign of the cross, interceded fervently, and he went for the FibroScan.
By God's grace, there were no issues there either, and it was completely cured with medication. After that, a red spot appeared in my own mouth, and its color started changing rapidly.
When I showed it to the doctor, I was told to wait for three months. "After that, we can do a biopsy or some further tests," the doctor said.
A couple of days later, I came here, took the anointing oil from the Menorah lamp, made the sign of the cross, and prayed.
Every single day I faithfully applied the Covenant salt and this holy oil. As a fruit of that prayer, the spot completely faded away even before the three months were up.
There is another testimony I have to share. This year, on January 18th For 14 long years, a property dispute case of ours had been dragging on in court.
The issue was that we owned 10 cents of land, and the neighboring family owned 9 cents.
Those with 9 cents were falsely claiming they needed 10 cents. There were constant arguments involving my mother and them, and the court battle was ongoing.
Finally, the court verdict came in our favor, granting us our rightful 10 cents. However, if they adjusted the boundaries to measure it out for them,
our 10 cents would shift into the property on the other side. If that happened, we would have to demolish right up to the wall of the neighboring house on that side.
They would never agree to that. If we adjusted the measurement and gave it to them, this case would end, but then we would have to enter a new legal battle with the other neighbors.
After the miraculous healing of that brother, everyone in my house entered into the Covenant. Many of my relatives are also in the Covenant now.
We move forward placing our complete trust in our Blessed Mother. We had immense faith. All of us sat together and interceded powerfully, praying that only the truth should triumph.
We prayed fervently to our Blessed Mother. As a result, officials and police from the court came twice to measure the land. Even when they measured, it didn't work out.
When they came for the third time, they requested more police presence and declared they would measure the land and build a dividing wall on January 18th.
We realized that if we didn't do something before the 18th, all would be lost and we wouldn't be able to do anything.
As we prayed powerfully to our Blessed Mother, we miraculously crossed paths with an official. I explained all these matters regarding our land to him.
He collected all the documents from me, examined them thoroughly, and then said
"Child, you must speak to the court officials exactly as I instruct you. You should also bring your own surveyor."
He explained everything to me clearly and taught me exactly what to do.
On the eve of the 18th, when they said they were coming, we called a surveyor, and that brother agreed to come. But when we called him in the morning,
that brother said he couldn't make it, as his wife was unwell and he had to go to Alappuzha. So, from Alappuzha to Thiruvananthapuram,
it was difficult to reach before noon, and he told me to call someone else. But we had a strong conviction that because we were in the Covenant,
and because Mother is the God of truth, our Mother would not abandon us. We powerfully applied the Covenant salt and interceded,
because it was only with that brother that I had shared everything the official had instructed me. Only he knew how to explain it to the court officials,
and only if that brother was with me could I properly explain everything. I was completely distressed, and all of us together prayed fervently to our Blessed Mother,
praying, "Mother, you are the Mother who shortens time. Whether he is in Alappuzha or anywhere else in the world, we know you will bring him here exactly on time."
We had an unwavering faith, and holding onto that faith, we prayed. By half-past ten, the officials from the court set out.
They went to the police station to bring the police along, and they had to wait there for a long time.
We kept on praying without ceasing, pleading that the officials should not arrive before the surveyor brother reached us. We all continued to pray together,
and Mother proved she is the Mother of time. Until that brother could travel from Alappuzha to our place in Thiruvananthapuram, the police were held up.
Because of that, they didn't come. It was past 1:30 when they finally left the station, and by the time they arrived to measure our land,
this brother was traveling from Alappuzha to Thiruvananthapuram. We didn't know how, but earlier he said he had reached Kottarakkara.
To reach our place from Kottarakkara in half an hour was humanly impossible. But through the Mother of time constraints, right at the exact moment they started he arrived!
It is impossible to travel from Kottarakkara to Varkala in half an hour, but somehow he reached there. Just as I mentioned,
the official who came from the court that day was not the same one who had come the previous two times. However, the surveyor was the same.
That surveyor and the lawyer were speaking in favor of the opposing party. Even though the court itself had granted us the 10 cents,
this lawyer and the surveyor from the court were still acting in favor of our opponents. We had only prayed for one thing,
that whoever it is, only the truth should triumph. "Mother, you must stand with the truth," we prayed, and Mother truly stood by the truth.
The new court official carefully listened to what I was saying and what the surveyor I brought was saying. He completely understood that the other side was lying,
and that only by unjustly adjusting the measurements could they make up their 10 cents. That was why they were trying to encroach and measure into the other property.
Realizing this, the official firmly said, "That is not acceptable. You must measure exactly as I instruct. First, measure the property on this side,"
"then measure and allocate their rightful land to them, and only after that, measure the rest for the others." They did not agree to this at first.
But finally, that official asserted, "No, that won't do. You must do it exactly as I say." Then, the surveyor who had come from the court,
had no choice but to listen to the official's orders. They measured our 10 cents perfectly and accurately, without encroaching on anyone else's property.
After that, the file was closed in court in such a way that it can never be reopened. Even if they try to file another case,
it cannot be reopened in any court because it is permanently closed. Having closed it like this, they can no longer do anything about it in any court.
So we were granted so many blessings in this way. Because we were completely ignorant about court proceedings, this surveyor and lawyer had been deceiving us.
But within that short time, meeting that good official, having him listen to my problems, and having him explain everything to me,
was truly the fruit of our intercession. Yes, it was the result of the powerful prayers of my family and me.
I had never even seen that official before in my life. We have an unshakable faith that it was our Blessed Mother who sent him specifically for us.
Otherwise, why would an official explain all these legal matters and teach me so thoroughly, especially when he hadn't even met me before?
There was absolutely no need for him to guide me like that. Not only that, after consuming the Covenant salt, I had prayed,
"Mother, when I speak, grant me the grace to say everything perfectly and exactly as that official taught me. It should not be me speaking, but Mother, you must speak."
And truly, it was Mother who spoke. That is why the official who came from the court understood everything clearly and resolved it for us.
In all these things, we tangibly experienced the presence of our Blessed Mother. I used to hear everyone testifying about seeing rainbows or experiencing the fragrance of jasmine.
So, one day, as I sat in my house near the window, looking up at the sky, reciting the Holy Rosary, and weeping in prayer,
I suddenly saw a green and red color blinking. It then formed into a massive, beautiful rainbow! It remained there for about 20 minutes.
I was overwhelmed with joy and even showed it to my husband. After that, my husband used to have a little complaint, saying, "You all get to see these signs and feel her presence, but only I am unable to."
So I told him to pray fervently to our Blessed Mother, and everything would be alright. One day, my husband prayed, saying, "Mother, you have shown your presence to everyone,
please let me also experience your holy presence." Now, my husband never used to put pictures of our Blessed Mother or Jesus on his mobile phone status.
He would only upload different photos of himself. But one day, while he was talking about the miracles of Kreupasanam to a staff member at his college,
he suddenly looked at his status and saw a picture of our Blessed Mother. He immediately called me and said, "Look at my status!"
I checked and told him, "It is your own photo." But he insisted, "No, what I see is the image of our Blessed Mother." A little while later, he called me again and said,
"Check it now." I replied, "No, it is still just your photo." When he opened it again, it had changed back to his own photo. Through this miraculous sign,
my husband powerfully experienced Mother's presence. As for the works of mercy we do, we have a group where everyone contributes money,
to help poor and sick people. We pack meals and distribute them in hospitals and along the streets. Moreover,
we collect the newsletters from here and distribute it to all the hospitals, homes, and everywhere we can. Also, we visit the Karunalayam in Attingal,
where we bathe the elderly mothers, feed them, and help the sisters who serve there.
These are the acts of mercy we are committed to. When we first took the Covenant, I did not have much of a prayer life.
But with the miraculous healing of that brother, all of us were drawn deeply into faith. Now, every morning and evening we have our family prayer.
I learned how to pray the Holy Rosary from a sister, and now we all pray the Rosary together and read the Holy Bible every single day.
These are the beautiful transformations that have happened in my spiritual life. My husband also prays the Rosary and reads the Bible daily,
and we watch the priest's Daily Bread reflection. We do all of this faithfully.
As it says in the Book of Genesis, chapter 28, verse 15, "Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go,"
Our Blessed Mother, who appeared alive in this holy sanctuary, will never abandon any of her children who come here praying with tears.
She is the Mother who shortens time, and she is always with us. All that Mother asks of us is faith, and more than faith, faithfulness in living out the Covenant.
When we move forward with faithfulness, Jesus and our Blessed Mother stand beside us. Just as these children testified, the Gospel of Matthew, chapter 21, verse 22, says,
"And whatever you ask in prayer, you will receive, if you have faith." These children prayed for everything with deep faith and unwavering loyalty, which is why,
Mother intervened in their lives in ways beyond their expectations. Just as Saint Paul says in his letter to the Romans, chapter 10, verse 11,
"No one who believes in him will be put to shame." With the children who stand firm in their faith and faithfully observe the Covenant life,
Jesus and our Mother are always present, ensuring we will never be put to shame. Our Mother will protect us and tenderly care for us.
Let us also stand united with Jesus and our Blessed Mother, for the Word of God promises, "Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go."
Kreupasanam is a place where the tangible presence of God is experienced. Every one of us who arrives here is tasting and experiencing that divine presence.
We are never alone. God is with us, and it is our Blessed Mother who gives us the courage to move forward in life. Let us pray that our Blessed Mother leads us,
into this profound experience of God's presence. For all the immense blessings received by Prakash, Ajina, and this brother, let us clap our hands and glorify God.
Thank you, Jesus! Praise you, Jesus! Ave Maria!
